thread:
Maya: Heads-up — canary cluster started hitting intermittent OOMs after the kernel-routing changes (commit abc123). Not huge scale but reproducing under our long-prompt mix. Suspect KV cache fragmentation + per-request cap interaction.
Kevin: Can you paste the top logs / OOM stack? is this prefill or decode path OOM?
Maya: Mostly during decode. Logs show lots of small workspace allocs and a spike in failed workspace grabs. gist: https://redwood/g/kv-oom-flame (flame + alloc timeline).
Anna: rough idea: when per-request cap is high we end up with more slab scattering; prefill makes it worse because we reserve larger blocks up-front. Might be a sizing/placement issue in allocator.
Devon: FWIW the kernel-routing change altered kernel selection for batch sizes ~8 which shifts memory layout — could increase small-frag allocations. We saw similar in july but not as severe.
Maya: flame shows heavy fragmentation between 32k and 256k arenas. profiler indicates decode holds onto buffers ~200-400ms longer; combined with prefill it pushes eviction freq.
Sam: quick mitigation options: rollback kernel-routing for canary, lower per-request cap to 32MB, or bump workspace slab coalesce. Which is least risky?
Anna: least risky is to lower per-request cap + soft-prefill throttle. Example quick config we can push to canary:
```
kv_cache:
  per_request_cap: 32MB
  prefill_reserve_pct: 0.10
  eviction_policy: size_then_age
  slab_coalesce: true
```
That should reduce new slab fragmentation while we bisect.
perf-bot: metric alert — canary OOM rate +118% over baseline in last 6h (see /metrics/canary/oom_rate).
Kevin: I'll run a mini-bisect on kernel-routing changes between abc123..def456 and capture heap snapshots. Command I'll use:
```
./scripts/run_repro.sh --profile --prompt-mix long --concurrency 12 --tag canary-bisect
```
Expect ~30m runs.
Devon: Also propose a small runtime change: return decode temporary buffers to recycler immediately after token write, rather than at request end. That reduces live set. Low-risk patch: decode-buffer-return PR #4299.
Maya: Good. Plan: 1) lower cap + prefill tweak to canary now (Anna), 2) Kevin bisect + heap snapshots, 3) Devon prepare PR for immediate buffer return, 4) run full-load perf test after fixes. I'll file issue #4287 and add acceptance criteria + repro links.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll monitor canary dashboards and hold rollback ready if OOM persists.
Anna: Pushed small config change to canary (rolled as feature-flag). Watching allocation heatmaps now.
Maya: Thanks — added notes to #4287 with flame link and sample logs. Kevin ping me with snapshot artifacts.
Kevin: Will upload snapshots to the bug and loop in runtime-sre for cross-check.
perf-bot: automation note — scheduled 3x perf runs tonight against canary-bisect tag.
Maya: OK team, let's reconvene once the bisect finishes. TL;DR: likely fragmentation interacting with per-request caps + kernel selection; short-term cap reduction + buffer-return should mitigate.
